close_reason: Fixed: moved issuer_has_crl_sign check to before verify_signature in crl.rs
description: File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs ~line 175-192. CRL signature is verified before issuer_has_crl_sign is checked. RFC 5280 §6.3.3 step (f) requires the cRLSign bit check first. Move the cRLSign KeyUsage check to before the verify_signature call.
title: P1: CRL: cRLSign check must occur before signature verification per RFC 5280 §6.3.3(f)
